target: direction of the next scheduled Bank of Canada policy announcement
cutoff: 16:00 America/Toronto on the weekday before the announcement
model: StandardScaler followed by multinomial logistic regression
model_selection: fixed specification; never tuned against the backtest
primary_question: accuracy on meetings where the Bank changed course
backtest_status: release-date-aware reconstruction on current numerical vintages; not a prospective test
same_day_releases: treated as unavailable; the release calendar has day precision only
text_features: not used; a lexicon over previous statements was tested and did not help
market_benchmark: not available; no meeting-specific timestamped OIS feed
